researchType: AI persona task trial; not real-human research

persona.scenario: A teacher invites families to a relaxed literacy evening and wants warm artwork while entering the practical details.
persona.successCriteria: Create one attractive Live Card, enter Monday's timing and clear family instructions, review and publish without duplicating wording or restarting artwork.

environment.status: Authenticated local updated UI tested through ordinary Chrome session

intendedInputs.openingLine: AI demo — not a real event
intendedInputs.occasion: Unspecified; choose a school/family category only if it clearly helps
intendedInputs.designPrompt: Create a warm, welcoming family literacy-night illustration inside a cozy elementary-school reading nook. A small blanket fort, open picture books with no readable book titles, soft amber string lights, floor cushions, and a friendly paper-cut owl form a clear central scene. Use rich teal, mustard, warm cream, and coral accents, layered paper textures, gentle depth, and soft evening lighting. Make it inviting for children ages 5–10 and their grown-ups, with no school logos, no recognizable children, and no implied real venue. Give the exact event title an expressive, easy-to-read storybook lettering treatment that fits the scene. Keep the supplied AI-demo opening line legible. Preserve the richness of the illustration rather than leaving a large blank center.
intendedInputs.guestMessage: AI demo — not a real event. This sample invitation shows a family literacy evening for children and their grown-ups. No school, venue, or participant is associated with this demonstration.
intendedInputs.additionalNotes: For the imagined activity: bring a favorite book and a blanket; grown-ups stay with children. The link is a demonstration destination only. No booking or live session exists.

execution.timingCaveat: Elapsed wall time includes orchestration pauses, tool setup, one 257-second download tool failure and suspended/resumed agent work. It is not an estimate of human task time. execution.attemptScope: One initial background plus lettering job; one explicit lettering-only repair after Publish rejected style findings. No background regeneration.

observedFriction: Venue name label suggests a physical place and rejects an explanatory online URL prefix; no online/in-person choice was visible.
A readable card was called Your design is ready and Your card is ready, yet Publish then blocked because of style_mismatch.
Lettering findings exposed long internal asset instructions and developer terminology before the visual Review card.
Optional wording correction prompt offered Apply wording suggestion without showing a concrete proposed edit.
simplificationSuggestions: Offer In person / Online before the location input; label the online field Event link and show detected link immediately.
Present one concise review issue such as Text decoration needs adjustment, keep the detailed explanation collapsed, and say clearly whether Publish is blocked.
Show exact before/after wording beside Apply suggestion.
Keep one coherent generation status and one Cancel generation control; move attempt number and timestamps to optional details.
productivityPreserved: Generate & continue opened logistics immediately, allowing Message and RSVP inspection during the real initial 65-second job.
No duplicate title/opening fields in Event details; summary retained wording clearly.
School family night could proceed with Occasion Not specified despite no school category.
Private draft saved successfully despite unresolved venue; no need to discard generated artwork.
One lettering repair preserves the existing reading-nook background and entered logistics.
